candidate.title: DR-Seq
candidate.scope: The middle DR-Seq row of the supplied Illumina schematic: joint processing of genomic DNA and polyadenylated mRNA from one cell, reverse transcription with a barcoded primer, joint Ad-2 quasilinear amplification, a split of amplified material, and separate transcript and genomic library routes to sequencing. The Dey et al. implementation clarifies this depiction. SIDR above and G&T-Seq below are neighboring rows, not alternative targets of this assigned DR-Seq card. No experimental interchangeability, historical-development edge, full-length transcript claim or unshown adaptation is asserted.
